findings.description: Function returns True when now equals expires_at, but the specification requires inactivity at or after expires_at.
findings.evidence: active(10,10) evaluates to True because the implementation uses now <= expires_at, but the spec states the token should be inactive when now >= expires_at.

review.summary: The implementation incorrectly treats the equality case as active, violating the contract that a token is active only strictly before the expiration timestamp.
